text: すこしは　やくに　たったじゃろう？

structure.jp: やくに　たったじゃろう？

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: じゃろう is the old-man form of だろう, which means 'probably' or asks 'right?'. やくに たったじゃろう = 'it was useful, wasn't it?'.

patterns.name: 〜は (at least)
patterns.explanation: は after an amount gives the feeling 'at least that much'. すこしは = 'at least a little'.
